bugs.text: slotPos() expects a slot object (slot.baseX/baseY) but every caller passes the numeric slot index stored in e.slot, so all formation positions are NaN. The formation never appears, enemies never fly in visibly, sway/breathe are invisible, returning divers vanish, and the stage can only be cleared by shooting enemies during the short mid-screen window of their dives. The play-test screenshots show no enemies at any time even though the score rises and ships are lost.
Because dive path points 0, 1 and 4 are NaN, a diver pops into existence at y=112 near the player and disappears at y=190; there is no visible approach from the formation or exit off the bottom.
Boss Galaga diving with two escorts scores 400*(1+2)=1200 instead of the spec's 1,600.

Captured-fighter bullets spawned while the Boss is at a NaN position have NaN coordinates, bypass the 24-bullet cap and are never culled; they accumulate until enemyFire() refuses to fire, silencing all regular enemy shots for the rest of the game.
Shooting a captive-holding Boss in formation (which should destroy the captive) can never happen because the Boss has no real position in formation; the captive is only ever freed.
The Boss starts returning to its (NaN) slot when captureT > 0.4, so the player ship being pulled up jumps to NaN and vanishes before the capture animation finishes.
A freed captive drops straight down from the Boss and docks only if the player happens to be within 10 px horizontally when it arrives; otherwise it falls off the screen and the dual fighter is lost.
Enemy hitboxes (12x12, Boss 14x12) are larger than the drawn sprites (10x10, 12x10, 12x10), so collisions with the player register before the sprites touch.
Tractor beam is gated to stage >= 2 and 28% of Boss dives, so with the formation bug most players will never see it.

summary: The file is cleanly organised (constants, sprite data, audio, state, update, render, fixed-step loop), well named and commented, and almost every subsystem the spec asks for is present: a proper 224x288 integer-scaled canvas, twinkling starfield, bitmap font, full HUD with flags, title score table, localStorage high score, two-shot limit, two-hit colour-changing Boss, escorted dives, a widening animated tractor beam, capture, rescue and dual fighter, five-wave challenging stages with correct bonuses, respawn with READY and dive suppression, and a near-complete synthesized sound set. All of that is undone by one type error: slotPos() is handed the slot index instead of the slot object, so every formation coordinate is NaN. The formation, the curved entries, sway and breathing never appear, divers only flash into view for the middle of their path, and the Boss can never be shot in formation. What a player sees is a starfield, their fighter, and enemies that materialise mid-screen, fire, and vanish; the score climbs and ships are lost, so it technically plays, but it does not feel like Galaga and stages are nearly impossible to clear.
